note: Rejudged after handleLCPPacket gained a Protocol-Reject branch for pkt.Code == LCPProtocolReject. Re-read Section 5.4. The rejection flags that sendConfigureRequest reads are still set in the unchanged Nak/Reject block ahead of the new branch, and a Reject never enters the branch. The tagged units are unchanged. Server MRU-only rejection still keeps the other original bytes, and MRU/Auth/Magic rejection still yields an empty request that a valid Ack advances. The client MRU-only, Magic-only and all-option cases still assert the exact surviving bytes, an unchanged retransmission and no resurrection from later Nak suggestions. The IPCP DNS control still removes both DNS options, or Secondary-DNS alone, and learns no rejected DNS. Removal and preservation remain distinct assertions, so the verdict holds.
